purpose: paper-facing formal subset for EchoMemory-MM benchmark development
selection_principles: cover temporal questions with absolute and relative dates
cover relation-heavy and multi-evidence synthesis questions
cover why/reason questions that require combining motivation with event state
cover detail grounding questions that test evidence precision rather than broad gist
avoid relying only on easy lexical overlap questions
notes: This subset is intended to be harder and more paper-representative than a 5-question smoke test.
It is still a subset, not a final benchmark table.
Future subset revisions should keep old IDs stable or bump the version.
